title: Sofia v3 Canonical Dashboard, Cytoscape Graph Explorer & Hybrid Telemetry Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Vanilla ESM preserved with zero bundler requirement
Cytoscape.js integrated as interactive semantic graph explorer behind renderer-independent adapter
Graph distinguishes node types, edge types, and 3-tier epistemic authority (canonical, derived, heuristic)
Graph supports search, filter, selection, inspection, fit/reset, and neighborhood traversal
Modular Apache ECharts integrated for real projection distributions without fabricated metrics
Native HTML/CSS status widgets handle compact meters, badges, and operational summaries
Runtime-status snapshot integrated with explicit refresh and degraded fallback
Deterministic scale fixtures (100, 1k, 5k nodes) pass performance benchmarks
All 5 graceful degradation failure modes verified without global dashboard crash
Read-only invariant and security authority verified (no write routes, no CDN, no secret leaks)
Full test suite, doctors, and linters pass cleanly
description: Implement the canonical Sofia v3 dashboard featuring Cytoscape.js graph exploration, modular ECharts distribution charts, native status widgets, and resilient graceful degradation.
